root_cause: The existing hourly CI collector computed its canonical accepted-job sample and a second semantic task projection independently. On future parser changes, 20 plausible tasks could be projected even if the canonical source estimator excluded or classified them differently.
fix: Cross-check bounded semantic task IDs, SHA, result, name and elapsed duration against canonical accepted executed-job rows from the identical GitHub response. Any mismatch suppresses all semantic proof; no new API reads or scheduler.
prevention_rule: Agents use only canonical_reconciled source-task evidence for CI/CD conclusions; keep bounded sample labels and do not infer critical path, autonomous permission, revenue or provider deployment from a sampled CI task.

invariants: Source-only proof never grants CI dispatch or production release
Every emitted task proof matches the original canonical estimator on run/attempt/job/SHA/result/timing
A partial or mismatching provider snapshot fails closed
No second telemetry collector or scheduler

release_requirement: Protected exact HEAD Required + CodeQL, main source readback and existing Janitor artifact verification; no claimed acceleration before measured outcomes
